Corgio.addToScript: Add new phrase for the character to bark
Corgio.addToScript|param|input: phrase to add to script, eg: "bark"
Corgio.bark: Have the character say one of the phrases in the script at random
Corgio.cameraFollow: Set camera to follow corgio horizontally, while keeping the screen centered vertically.
Corgio.horizontalMovement: Make the character move in the direction indicated by the left and right arrow keys.
Corgio.updateSprite: Make the character change sprite images when moving.
Corgio.verticalMovement: Make the character jump when the up arrow key is pressed, and grab onto the wall when falling.
corgio: Sprite Wrapper for a Corgi Platformer
corgio.create: Creates a new corgi from an image and kind
corgio.create|param|kind: the kind to make the corgi
